author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮನದತ್ಯಾಜ್ಯವ ಕಳೆಯೆ ಆತ್ಮಶಾಂತಿಯ ಮೆರುಗು
ತನುವ ಕೊಳೆಗಳ ತೊಳೆಯೆ ಅದೃಶ್ಯ ವ್ಯಾಧಿ
ಅನುಭಾವ ಅನುಭವವು ಚೈತನ್ಯ ಮೂಡಿಸಿರೆ
ತನುಮನವ ಶುದ್ಧವಿಡು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Clear away the mind's refuse, and the soul's peace shines;
wash off the body's grime, and illness disappears;
when realisation and experience awaken vitality,
keep body and mind pure, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Cleaning out the clutter of the mind brings a glow of inner peace, and keeping the body clean keeps illness away. When what we realise within and what we live through outside fill us with energy, we should keep both body and mind pure.
